notes: BETA: actually fixes the 'pdfplumber not available' error. Root cause was charset-normalizer's mypyc-compiled build whose shared runtime module wasn't bundled; the build now uses the pure-Python charset-normalizer. Verified pdfplumber imports in the frozen exe. Also adds Log → Send Logs to Support, which uploads your log and gives you a private link to share for remote troubleshooting. Carries the vendor price list multipliers, PDF reader, and Deluxe pricing from earlier betas.
